name: Parish Safeguarding Dashboard
shortDescription: Church of England safeguarding-administration dashboard for parishes in participating dioceses, developed by Clearly Simpler.
suitableContexts: Church of England parishes in a participating diocese
Parish safeguarding officers and PCCs needing a structured administrative dashboard

pricing.summary: The Dashboard is supplied through participating dioceses rather than as a published self-serve parish subscription. Several dioceses describe it as free to their parishes; ask the diocesan safeguarding team about local access and any funding arrangement.
pricing.trialDetails: Access is arranged through a participating diocese; no individual parish trial is advertised.

gdprInformation: Clearly Simpler publishes a data-processing agreement for its Safeguarding Hubs. Parish Safeguarding Dashboard users should obtain the current diocesan agreement, privacy information and local controller/processor arrangements before entering personal data.
coreFeatures: Guidance and information pages for dashboard tasks
Access for authorised parish and diocesan users
support: Access and first-line support through participating diocesan safeguarding teams

church-of-england-scope.value: Supplier states that the Dashboard was developed by Clearly Simpler for use within the Church of England.

diocesan-access.value: Diocesan sources say access is organised through the diocesan safeguarding team and describe the Dashboard as free to parishes in participating dioceses.

supplier-identity.value: Clearly Simpler identifies itself as a UK company and a diocesan source attributes the Dashboard to the supplier.

editorial.assessment: The Parish Safeguarding Dashboard is a specialist Church of England administration tool, not a substitute for safeguarding judgement, diocesan advice or incident-management procedures. It is particularly relevant where a participating diocese has adopted it and can provide its local access, training and data-governance arrangements.
bestFor: Church of England parishes in a diocese that provides the Dashboard
Parish safeguarding officers coordinating policy, training and governance checks
strengths: Purpose-built for Church of England parish safeguarding administration
limitations: Not a replacement for professional safeguarding advice or statutory reporting
Data, access and local policy arrangements must be agreed with the diocese

procurementVerdict.problem: Keeping parish safeguarding tasks, policy reviews and governance oversight organised
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Church of England-specific framework supplied through a diocesan safeguarding model
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask the diocesan safeguarding team whether the Dashboard is available and what records should or should not be held in it

Diocese of Portsmouth: Parish Safeguarding Dashboard
supports: Free parish access in that diocese

seo.description: Independent Parish Safeguarding Dashboard profile: Church of England scope, diocesan access, workflow and data-governance checks.
